name: United States to Visakhapatnam — Long-Haul Suez Transit & Bunker Volatility
disclaimer: [DEMO] Synthetic scenario parameters for demonstration purposes.

test_vessels.reason: Panamax fits US East Coast coal berths (Hampton Roads/Baltimore) and Visakhapatnam outer harbour
Supramax fits all ports but has higher USD/MT on long voyages

expected_outcomes.key_insight: Extremely long 12,900 NM voyage with $250k Suez canal toll and ~37 sea days. High fuel burn amplifies bunker sensitivity. Medium-Term COA protects against long-haul freight rate volatility, yielding significant predictable savings vs unhedged spot exposure.
